title: Taiwan Detects 3 PLA Aircraft Sorties Crossing into Northern ADIZ
detail: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense detected 3 PLA aircraft sorties operating around Taiwan in the 24 hours to 6 a.m. (UTC+8) September 9, 2026, alongside PLAN vessels and official ships patrolling the theater; 2 of the 3 sorties crossed the Taiwan Strait median line, entering the northern ADIZ sector. Taiwan's armed forces responded with CAP aircraft, navy ships and coastal missile systems. The tally continued the sharp pullback from the Sept 7-8 surge (29 and 27 sorties respectively, the window's high), consistent with the post-exercise fluctuation pattern MND has reported since Han Kuang 42 concluded in mid-August.
